site.name: Amazon at Manaus
site.tagline: The flood pulse of the Amazon

params.water_calibration: Rio Negro at Manaus (water) vs Terra firme forest, Reserva Ducke (check area) (dry land)
params.water_rule: HH and HV below thresholds calibrated on a permanent reference lake, or both channels at least 3 dB darker than the pixel's own median
params.flood_rule: HH rise >= 3 dB above pixel median, HH rise exceeds HV rise by >= 2 dB, HH >= -6 dB, not built-up

classes.4: no valid radar data (masked swath gap)

ducke-forest.name: Terra firme forest, Reserva Ducke (check area)

rio-negro.name: Rio Negro at Manaus
rio-negro.note: Wide black-water river channel, used as the permanent water reference.

meeting-waters.name: Meeting of the Waters
meeting-waters.note: Where the dark Rio Negro meets the muddy Solimoes to form the Amazon.

careiro-varzea.name: Careiro varzea floodplain
careiro-varzea.note: Seasonally flooded forest, lakes and pasture on the Solimoes floodplain.

janauari.name: Lago do Janauari area
janauari.note: Floodplain lakes and flooded forest south of the Rio Negro.

manaus-city.name: Manaus city
manaus-city.note: City of about two million people.

ducke-forest.name: Terra firme forest, Reserva Ducke (check area)
ducke-forest.note: Upland rainforest that never floods. Used as the dry-land reference.

rain.source: NASA GPM IMERG Late Run daily, V07, 0.1 degree (GES DISC)
rain.caveat: Satellite estimate on a 0.1 degree (about 11 km) grid, averaged over each area. Late Run products are calibrated less than the Final Run, which is not yet available for 2026.
